name: English Stud
description: English Stud is a 7-card stud variant where players have the unique option to exchange cards during the deal. Deal and play follow standard 7-card stud, but after each betting round (following the 5-card and 6-card streets), each player can optionally exchange one card for a new one. This card exchange feature distinguishes English Stud from traditional 7-card stud.

history.origins: British adaptation of American 7-card stud; Pot-Limit and club rules common in UK card rooms.
timeline: Present: Played in European mixed games
history.cultural: Popular in UK poker clubs and European casinos as a mid-stakes game variant.
history.evolution: Emerged directly from standard 7-card stud by adding optional card exchange mechanic to increase strategic options.

setup.players: Two to six players. Six is the maximum for this variant so the deck suffices for the deal and two optional single-card exchange rounds; with five or fewer players a seventh face-down card may be dealt as in standard seven-card stud. Best with five or six players for balance of action and card availability.
setup.dealing: Same as 7-card stud. Betting structure often Pot-Limit or Spread-Limit (local rules).

rules.objective: Make the best five-card poker hand from seven cards; high hand wins the pot.
rules.gameplay: Standard 7-card stud deal with card exchanges. After the fifth card betting round, each player can optionally exchange one card. After the sixth card betting round, another exchange round occurs. Each exchange can involve either a face-down card or a face-up card. The seventh card and final betting round follow standard 7-card stud. Maximum 6 players to ensure sufficient cards.
keyRules: Deal follows 7-card stud structure (2 down, 1 up, then 3 more up, then 1 down)
After 5-card street betting, optional single-card exchange for each player
After 6-card street betting, another optional single-card exchange
Can exchange face-down card for face-down, or face-up for face-up
Sixth card dealt face-up, seventh card dealt face-down
Standard poker hand ranking; high hand wins
Maximum 6 players; with five or fewer a seventh face-down card is dealt

strategy.basic: As 7-card stud; adjust to Pot-Limit if used.

scoring.description: Each player makes the best five-card poker hand from their seven cards. Standard poker hand rankings determine the winner.
scoring.winCondition: At showdown, the player with the highest-ranking 5-card poker hand wins the pot. If all other players fold before showdown, the remaining player wins without revealing their hand.

synthesis.shortDescription: English Stud is a 7-card stud poker variant featuring optional single-card exchanges after the fifth and sixth streets. Players can swap either face-down or face-up cards before continuing play, adding an extra layer of strategy to traditional 7-card stud.
